page_title: DOR 0-1 LEV | Dortmund v Bayer Leverkusen 11/04/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+4' The ball goes out of play. Dortmund are awarded a corner kick.
90+3' Close! A mistake by a defender gifts Julian Brandt (Dortmund) a chance inside the box, but his efforts curls just around the right post.
90+2' Today's match ends for Ibrahim Maza who will be replaced by Malik Tillman (Bayer Leverkusen).
90+2' Ramy Bensebaini (Dortmund) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
90+1' Julian Brandt (Dortmund) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
90' 3 additional min. will be played.
90' Maximilian Beier (Dortmund) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
89' Ernest Poku (Bayer Leverkusen) bursts past a couple of players and shoots from the edge of the box, but his shot is blocked.
88' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
87' Patrik Schick (Bayer Leverkusen) peeled away from his marker and got on the end of the corner, but his fine header towards the right post is brilliantly saved by the diving goalkeeper.
86' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
86' Lucas Vazquez (Bayer Leverkusen) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
85' Patrik Schick (Bayer Leverkusen) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
83' Serhou Guirassy (Dortmund) storms into the box to get on the end of a pass, but smashes his shot straight onto the crossbar. Unlucky!
82' Samuele Inacio (Dortmund) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
81' Ramy Bensebaini (Dortmund) receives a pass and unleashes a shot which goes well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bayer Leverkusen.
81' The up-to-date shots on target statistics – 1:3.
79' PENALTY APPEAL after Serhou Guirassy (Dortmund) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
76' The substitution is prepared. Salih Ozcan (Dortmund) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Jobe Bellingham.
75' Niko Kovac has decided to substitute Julian Ryerson and he is replaced by Almugera Kabar (Dortmund).
75' Dortmund are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
75' The attendance is 81365.
74' Kasper Hjulmand prepares a substitution. Montrell Culbreath is replaced by Lucas Vazquez (Bayer Leverkusen).
74' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Nathan Tella departs the field of play to be replaced by Ernest Poku (Bayer Leverkusen).
72' Julian Ryerson (Dortmund) takes a direct free kick.

70' Nathan Tella (Bayer Leverkusen) collects a great pass inside the box and misses a golden opportunity. His low drive is headed for the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper pulls off a marvellous diving save and denies him.
70' Bayer Leverkusen seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
68' The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Bayer Leverkusen.

68' Ibrahim Maza (Bayer Leverkusen) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The ball is out of play. Bayer Leverkusen win a corner kick.
64' Niko Kovac decides to make a substitution. Fabio Silva will be replaced by Samuele Inacio (Dortmund).
64' A substitution has been made. Marcel Sabitzer goes off and Carney Chukwuemeka (Dortmund) comes on.
63' Deniz Aytekin shows a yellow card to Maximilian Beier (Dortmund) for a tough tackle.
61' Bayer Leverkusen get a corner.

61' Patrik Schick (Bayer Leverkusen) receives a diagonal pass, bursts into the box and shoots towards the left side of the goal. Gregor Kobel is well positioned, though, and it's a comfortable save. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Bayer Leverkusen will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
59' Niko Kovac has decided to make a change. Maximilian Beier (Dortmund) replaces Daniel Svensson.
56' Marcel Sabitzer (Dortmund) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Deniz Aytekin blows for a foul. Bayer Leverkusen are awarded a free kick.
54' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Patrik Schick (Bayer Leverkusen) is coming onto the pitch as Christian Kofane cannot continue after picking up an injury.
53' Julian Brandt (Dortmund) steps up and sends the mid-range free kick miles over the bar. Strong but inaccurate shot. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bayer Leverkusen.
52' Poor challenge! Robert Andrich (Bayer Leverkusen) is penalised for tripping and Deniz Aytekin blows his whistle. Dortmund win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
50' Julian Brandt (Dortmund) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
47' The referee awards a corner and Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) goes over to take it.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+2' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45' Serhou Guirassy (Dortmund) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Deniz Aytekin didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.
44' Julian Ryerson (Dortmund) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.

42' 0 - 1 What a beautiful moment! Robert Andrich (Bayer Leverkusen) got to the ball and unleashed a strong shot from distance. It turned out to be a good decision as his effort found its way into the bottom left corner. Gregor Kobel just shakes his head in disbelief. The score changes to 0:1.
40' Daniel Svensson (Dortmund) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
39' Marcel Sabitzer (Dortmund) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. Dortmund force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
38' Julian Brandt (Dortmund) collects a pass on the edge of the box but he slips the ball just wide of the right post.

35' The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Dortmund. Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) controls a square pass, he moves forward then unleashes a wild shot from mid-range which goes so far wide it nearly hits the corner flag.
34' Aleix Garcia (Bayer Leverkusen) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
33' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen). Bayer Leverkusen have been awarded a corner kick.

32' Christian Kofane (Bayer Leverkusen) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the penalty area and shoots towards the middle of the goal. He didn't put enough power into the effort, though, and Gregor Kobel pulls off an easy save.

32' Ibrahim Maza (Bayer Leverkusen) creates some space for himself to pick up a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a decent strike which goes a whisker over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Dortmund will have a goal kick.

30' That was close by Aleix Garcia (Bayer Leverkusen)! He receives a pass on the edge of the box and shoots, but the ball goes inches wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Dortmund.

28' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Bayer Leverkusen are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
26' Wonderful movement by Dortmund. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
22' The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Dortmund.

21' Daniel Svensson (Dortmund) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away. The ball is out of play. Dortmund will have a chance to score from a corner.
20' The referee blows his whistle, a clear handball by Nathan Tella (Bayer Leverkusen). It's a free kick to Dortmund, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.

20' The defence had a hard time blocking out the strike from Nathan Tella (Bayer Leverkusen). He didn't hesitate and finished from outside the box right after he had received a pass from his teammate.
18' Daniel Svensson (Dortmund) gathers a nice lofted pass just outside the box and attempts to put the ball into the top right corner, but his shot is deflected by one of the defending players away.
16' Julian Brandt (Dortmund) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
13' Bayer Leverkusen are just stroking the ball across the park now, but the defence is doing very well breaking up their possession.
11' The percentage of ball possession is – 75:25.

8' Dortmund slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
6' Deniz Aytekin blows his whistle as Christian Kofane (Bayer Leverkusen) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack. Dortmund will take a free kick near the side line.
6' The game is interrupted now, Marcel Sabitzer (Dortmund) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
5' Deniz Aytekin shows the yellow card to Ramy Bensebaini (Dortmund) for a heavy challenge.
4' Serhou Guirassy (Dortmund) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
3' The referee signals a corner kick to Dortmund.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
Dortmund will kick the game off.
